description: Overall CGPA from semester SGPAs. Mode "credit-weighted" (used by most universities) weights each SGPA by its semester credits; "equal-average" takes the simple mean of SGPAs.

scale_max.description: Grading scale maximum, e.g. 10 for Indian universities, 4 for US GPA. Default 10.

name: calculate_cgpa_from_semesters
title: Combine semester SGPAs into CGPA
